_comment: BREAKEVEN exit calibration. Forces UseBreakeven=1; after price runs BreakevenArmATR×EntryATR in favor, exits at the first close back at/below entry. Needs ATRPeriod>0. Run only if the screen kept UseBreakeven ON. go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker EUTR -strategy reversion -interval Hour1 -calibrate data/params/eutr/reversion_cal_breakeven.json -out ./reports/EUTR_be -months 31 -train-months 12 -test-months 6 -metric profit_factor -min-trades 20
